design: Same 72 candidates and five outer district folds; inner candidate-selection folds hold out complete regions; calibration folds repeat selection inside their training partitions
primary_objective: pooled recall at 20% capacity; AP tie-break; AP-selected control
interpretation: Adaptive exploratory extension motivated by earlier retrospective results; later outcomes are excluded from selection, but this is not independent external confirmation
threshold_and_weights: unchanged candidate grid and 20% capacity; no temporal threshold search
